Name: DowloadScript
CreateTicket
Content:
declare @ticket varchar(32), @filename varchar(128), @description nvarchar(128)
select @ticket = lower(replace(newid(),'-',''))
if @@language = 'v' select @filename = 'BudgetArticle.xlsx', @description = N'Danh mục chỉ tiêu ngân sách'
else select @filename = 'BudgetArticle2.xlsx', @description = N'Budget Article List'
insert into @@sysDatabaseName..ticket values(@ticket, @@userID, 'BudgetArticle', @filename, @description, '@@appDatabaseName', getdate());
